mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM logistics_provider WHERE id=#{providerId} AND status='ACTIVE')
SELECT FROM bill_import_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND provider_id=#{providerId} AND file_hash=#{fileHash}
SELECT FROM bill_import_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{batchId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bill_import_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND provider_id=#{providerId} AND status=#{status}
SELECT FROM bill_import_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND provider_id=#{providerId} AND status=#{status} ORDER BY imported_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE bill_import_batch SET total_count=#{total},success_count=#{success},failure_count=#{failure},status=#{status},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{batchId} AND status='PROCESSING' AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bill_detail WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND bill_import_batch_id=#{batchId} AND detail_status=#{status}
SELECT FROM bill_detail WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND bill_import_batch_id=#{batchId} AND detail_status=#{status} ORDER BY bill_import_batch_id DESC,line_no ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM bill_detail WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND provider_id=#{providerId} AND provider_bill_detail_no=#{providerBillDetailNo}

SELECT o.id,o.current_fee,o.currency FROM shipment_order o JOIN warehouse_outbound_record w ON w.shipment_order_id=o.id AND w.tenant_id=o.tenant_id WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND w.provider_id=#{providerId} AND w.tracking_no=#{trackingNo}
SELECT FROM bill_detail WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND bill_import_batch_id=#{batchId} AND line_no=#{lineNo}
SELECT FROM reconciliation_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{reconciliationId}
SELECT FROM reconciliation_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND bill_detail_id=#{billDetailId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reconciliation_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_order_id=#{orderId} AND reconciliation_status=#{status}
SELECT FROM reconciliation_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_order_id=#{orderId} AND reconciliation_status=#{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE reconciliation_record SET reconciliation_status='CONFIRMED',resolution_type=#{resolutionType},remark=#{remark},confirmed_by=#{confirmedBy},confirmed_at=#{confirmedAt},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{reconciliationId} AND reconciliation_status='PENDING_CONFIRMATION' AND version=#{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (tenant_id,operator_user_id,action_type,resource_type,resource_id,request_id,result_status,reason,detail,occurred_at) VALUES (#{tenantId},#{operatorUserId},#{actionType},#{resourceType},#{resourceId},#{requestId},'SUCCESS',#{reason},CAST(#{detail} AS JSON),#{occurredAt})
